changes.summary: Retained-power time after ignition off goes from 45 s to 60 s. The front-door condition is unchanged. This also settles the old conflict with deleted WLC-023, which said 60 s.

The vague, untestable 'close quickly on rain' becomes a defined trigger and behaviour: on the CAN request WLC_CloseAll from the body controller, close in express mode with anti-pinch active. The rain sensor is no longer named as the trigger.
Pinch-detection force threshold in the pinch zone drops from 100 N to 80 N.
Minimum reversal distance after a pinch goes from 125 mm to 150 mm, or to fully open, whichever is less. The 10 ms stop time is unchanged.
'set itself to not normalized' becomes 'set its state to not normalized'. The trigger (interruption longer than 500 ms) and the behaviour are unchanged.
Vague limits get numbers: the trigger is now an estimated motor temperature above 130 °C (was 'the limit'), and the action is to limit motor current to 15 A (was 'reduce to a safe value').
WLC_Status cycle time goes from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. Content (position, movement state, normalization state, fault state) is unchanged.

WLC-030 now only requires storing B1A02 (more than 25 A for more than 50 ms). Stopping the motor and setting the fault state move to new WLC-037 and WLC-038. The overall intent looks the same, but the trigger for those actions is now 'when B1A02 is stored' instead of the overcurrent event (see concerns).

tests.reason: WLC-032 is deleted, so remove its trace; keep the test under WLC-004, but only if WLC-004 really contains the 100 µA limit (see concerns).

tests.new_procedure: Switch ignition off. Press the window switch at 55 s (inside the window) and at 65 s (outside it). Repeat with a front door opened at 10 s, then press the switch at 15 s. Remove the trace to deleted WLC-023.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Window movement allowed after ignition off, with no front door opened
Window movement allowed after a front door is opened during the retained-power period
new_pass_criteria.limit: Until a front door is opened, whichever comes first

tests.reason: The time changed from 45 s to 60 s, so the old 40 s / 50 s check points no longer bracket the limit, and the trace to deleted WLC-023 must go.

tests.new_procedure: Window half open, controller normalized. Send the CAN request WLC_CloseAll and observe the close. Repeat with the 10 N/mm pinch rod in the pinch zone to confirm anti-pinch is active during the CloseAll movement. Retitle the test (no rain signal any more).

new_pass_criteria.measure: Window closes on WLC_CloseAll, movement mode
Anti-pinch protection during WLC_CloseAll close (pinch detected and reversed per WLC-014/WLC-015)

tests.reason: The trigger changed from a rain signal to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, and the requirement now asks for express mode with anti-pinch active, so the old procedure and the 'window closes' criterion no longer verify it.

tests.new_procedure: At 13.5 V and 23 °C, express close onto the 10 N/mm pinch rod placed at 100 mm (force crosses 80 N after about 8 mm compression). Record force, motor stop time and reversal distance.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Pinch detected when pinch force exceeds
Motor stop time after pinch detection
Reversal distance after pinch
new_pass_criteria.limit: At least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.reason: The force threshold (100 to 80 N) and the reversal distance (125 to 150 mm) both changed.

WLC-018 is deleted, so remove the trace, but do not retire the test: the lower 80 N threshold makes false reversals on rough roads more likely, and LL-2021-07 requires a new false-reversal check (see concerns).
The WLC-021 change is wording only, and the 400 ms / 600 ms points still bracket the unchanged 500 ms threshold.

tests.new_procedure: Run open-close cycles while logging the estimated motor temperature and the motor current. Check that no limiting happens while the estimate is at or below 130 °C, then continue until the estimate exceeds 130 °C and measure the current. Check that the estimate is current at the moment of the limit check (LL-2024-01).

new_pass_criteria.measure: Temperature estimate at which current limiting starts
Motor current while the estimated temperature exceeds 130 °C

tests.reason: The vague 'limit' and 'safe value' are now 130 °C and 15 A, so the old 'current reduced' criterion is no longer enough.

tests.new_procedure: Record WLC_Status for 10 s while moving the window, both on a quiet bus and at worst-case bus load including an active diagnostic session (LL-2024-09). Repeat the worst-case transmit-queue calculation for the 50 ms cycle.

new_pass_criteria.measure: WLC_Status transmission period
Signals present: window position, movement state, normalization state, fault state

tests.reason: The cycle time changed from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms.
The criteria (B1A02 stored, motor stopped, fault state set) still cover the split requirements, but add traces to WLC-037 and WLC-038 and rerun so the evidence is recorded against the new structure.
Its only requirement, WLC-033, is deleted, and its 4-of-5 rating limit was never in any requirement, so it verifies nothing in the new version.

added.extend_test: New test needed (e.g. TC-AP-10), using the TC-AP-01 setup. TC-AP-08 (repeated pinch lockout) is the closest neighbour and should be rerun for interaction. Procedure: cause a pinch reversal, request express close (switch short press, and also WLC_CloseAll) at about 1.5 s and at about 2.5 s after the reversal.
added.pass_criteria: Express close request after a pinch reversal: inhibited for 2 s. An express close request after the 2 s has passed: accepted. Open points: when the 2 s starts (pinch detection or end of reversal), and whether manual close is affected. These need clarifying before the limit can be applied unambiguously.

added.extend_test: Extend TC-DG-02 (block the window, inject 27 A for 100 ms). Add a below-threshold case (27 A for 40 ms, no DTC) to confirm the trigger chain.
added.pass_criteria: When B1A02 is stored: motor stopped. The requirement gives no time limit; if one is needed, take it from WLC-031 (diagnostic response time) rather than inventing one.

added.extend_test: Extend TC-DG-02. Decode WLC_Status during and after the injected overcurrent.
added.pass_criteria: When B1A02 is stored: fault state set in WLC_Status (seen in the transmitted WLC_Status frames).

concerns.concern: Lowering the threshold from 100 N to 80 N raises the risk of false reversals on rough roads. LL-2021-07 says any threshold change needs a new check of both false reversals and stop time. Keep and rerun this test, and ask for a measurable replacement for deleted WLC-018 (a defined vibration profile, with zero false pinch detections) so the test traces to something again.
LL-2022-02: cold plus low voltage is the worst case for stop time. With the new 80 N / 150 mm values, run it on every release, not only at the end of the program.
Pinch protection in manual and express mode (WLC-016) uses the same detection threshold. Rerun it with 80 N and 150 mm reversal even though it does not trace to a changed requirement.
Repeated pinch lockout (WLC-019) interacts with the new 2 s express-close inhibit (WLC-039) and the longer reversal. Rerun it and check the two features do not conflict.

WLC-012 asks for express close with anti-pinch active, but WLC-017 turns anti-pinch off when not normalized, and TC-MV-08 / WLC-013 allow express close only when normalized. Clarify what WLC_CloseAll should do when not normalized, and whether the WLC-039 inhibit applies to WLC_CloseAll. Also confirm with the body-controller owner that rain closing now comes through WLC_CloseAll.
Express close only when normalized: rerun it with WLC_CloseAll as a new express-close source.

The 100 µA limit came from deleted WLC-032. Confirm that WLC-004 contains a sleep-current limit; if not, the test has no limit and the deletion may be a mistake (quiescent current is normally a vehicle-level need). Also, with retained power now 60 s, the procedure's 60 s wait may overlap the end of retained power, so check the controller is really asleep before measuring.

New WLC-037/038 say 'when B1A02 is stored'. A stored DTC stays in memory, so read literally the motor must stay stopped and the fault flag stay set until the DTC is cleared. That is a behaviour change from the old event-based WLC-030. Clarify the intent and test whether movement is possible after the overcurrent ends, with the DTC still stored.

WLC-025 now uses a fixed 130 °C limit on the temperature estimate, so the estimate's accuracy and freshness decide the result. LL-2024-01: check the estimate is current at the limit check, and that the fix is present in the shared platform thermal module (also used by WLC-200).
TC-TH-03 and TC-TH-04 (opening blocked when hot, release) should be checked against the new 130 °C / 15 A limit for consistent thresholds and sequencing.
With current limited to 15 A when hot, full close time (WLC-010) may not be met, and the lower pinch threshold may cause false reversals near the seal. Rerun it, including a hot case.

At 85 °C ambient, the motor estimate may pass 130 °C during the test, so the 15 A limit could interact with anti-pinch detection. Log the estimated temperature, and add a pinch case with current limiting active.

LL-2024-09: halving the cycle time to 50 ms needs the worst-case transmit-queue calculation repeated, and a test under maximum bus load with a diagnostic session. The bus load also affects reception of the new WLC_CloseAll request.
Diagnostic response time (WLC-031) may include reporting through WLC_Status, whose cycle is now 50 ms. Rerun it, and use it as the timing reference for WLC-037/038.
Hall sensor loss: rerun it at the lowest supply voltage with the sensor removed while the motor runs (LL-2023-05), and check that fault state reporting works at the new 50 ms cycle.
Full function across the supply range (WLC-001) includes anti-pinch, so rerun it with the new thresholds. TC-AP-02 covers only the 9.0 V point.
Climatic operation (WLC-035) shares its traces with TC-AP-04/05. Rerun it after the anti-pinch parameter changes.

The test is retired for traceability, but the switch-feel review may still be worth keeping as an informal, non-verification activity if the product owner wants it. Deleted WLC-034 (software process) has no tests, but process compliance is still a project obligation outside this specification.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
